document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your medical knowledge helps the stranger to rally for a time. 
He  tells  you  his  name—Jacob  McCarthy—and  some  of  his 
story. He was prospecting in the valley, but was set upon by 
“midget Indians.” He fled, but got lost and began to starve. He 
still carries the map of his gold discovery.

He knows these are his final hours and gives you the map out 
of gratitude. After you bury him, you are even more anxious to 
get home.
Record the keyword RESONATE. Go to 513.
